items.question: Can you remove a shadow ban?
items.answer: Yes. We diagnose the content and policy triggers, submit evidence-backed appeals, and rebuild your posting plan to avoid future strikes.

items.question: How fast do you recover hijacked accounts?

items.question: Do you work with non-Persian teams?
